2.49.28
List.ReportItems
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The List.ReportItems element specifies a collection of the elements of a list layout. This element is
optional and is of type ReportItems.
Following is the parent element of the List.ReportItems element.
Parent elements
 List
The following is the XML Schema definition of the List.ReportItems element.
 <xsd:element name="ReportItems" type="ReportItemsType" minOccurs="0" />
